title: Cost Segregation: Model the Deduction and the Usable Loss Separately
description: Cost segregation changes depreciation timing, but a larger deduction is not the same as a larger current tax benefit. Follow a property example through loss usability.

title: Short-Term Rental Participation: What the Records Need to Show
description: A short guest stay does not by itself establish a deductible nonpassive loss. This guide separates rental classification, material participation and supporting records.

title: Rental Losses and the 2026 Excess Business Loss Threshold
description: A nonpassive rental loss can still be limited under Section 461(l). See how the 2026 threshold fits a large real estate depreciation deduction.

title: Rental Repairs or Improvements: Build the File Before Claiming a Deduction
description: A contractor invoice can include deductible repairs and capital improvements. Learn how to document the work, costs and treatment before filing a rental return.

title: Rental Placed-in-Service Dates: Evidence Beyond the Closing Statement
description: Buying a property and placing it in service are different events. Build an evidence file that supports when depreciation begins for a rental asset.

title: Rental Property Sale Planning: Depreciation and the Exit Model
description: A depreciation strategy should include the eventual sale. Follow an adjusted-basis example and identify the records needed for a property exit review.

title: Real Estate Investor Tax Playbook: AE Tax Advisors Companion Reading Guides
description: Read six focused real estate investor tax playbook companion guides with worked examples, records checklists, IRS references and links to published AE Tax Advisors case studies.
